citizenship.objective: Community resilience project: reach 50 project points per round together, while balancing personal earnings and peer-rated citizenship.
citizenship.scoring: Team grade = project completion %. Peer average / team peer average, capped at 1.05, adjusts each individual grade. Earnings stay separate.

pricing.assumptions: Planning estimate: 2,500 base input tokens per turn, accumulated thread history, 350 output tokens per decision, and 900 for final peer review. Assumes no cached-input discount. The 0.5–2× range is illustrative, not a cap; tool calls, reasoning, retries and longer responses can exceed it. Credits are not converted to USD.

data.title: Shared-fund responsibility experiment
rules: Each agent receives $10 per round. The participation rule requires a $5 contribution.
The shared fund doubles and pays every agent an equal share, including non-contributors.
Contributions generate community project points toward a 50-points-per-round team target; final peer reviews determine individual project grades.
All five submit privately. Contributions and messages are revealed together after every valid submission.
